title: CAD/case-report crosscheck against 13 ALPR search IDs, 3 incidents
summary: For each of three CAD/incident numbers (202504040004 on 4/4/2025; 202512050234 on 12/5/2025; 202503280193 on 3/28/2025), asks for (1) the CAD event chronology/unit history/dispatch log and (2) the incident/case report including any assigned RMS case number and disposition. Separately, Item 3 asks for any record or log entry maintained through the Department's Flock ALPR system corresponding to thirteen named search IDs, invoking the Department's own case-number-entry requirement for ALPR searches as context. SMPD produced the three CAD incident reports (Item 1), answered "No responsive records" for any incident/case report (Item 2), and deferred Item 3 to the W012541-041426 rolling production.

policy_promises.quote: records of investigations conducted by ... any state or local police agency
policy_promises.tests: Whether a blanket exemption claim survives where Items 1 and 2 (CAD chronology, case report) would themselves establish that a given incident did not result in an investigation. Answered in part: SMPD withheld portions of the 202503280193 CAD under § 7923.600 while answering "No responsive records" for any incident or case report on it, and the CAD shows disposition CM with no case number.

policy_promises.quote: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection ... after deletion of the portions that are exempt by law
policy_promises.tests: Whether the CAD chronology (an operational dispatch record) is segregable from any narrative report content withheld under § 7923.600 for the same call.

policy_promises.quote: Every ALPR data search shall be documented with a reason for the search, usually by agency case number, incident number, or warrant number.
policy_promises.tests: Whether the incidents cited for ALPR searches correspond to documented investigations. For all three incidents SMPD produced a CAD record with a blank Case Number field and answered "No responsive records" for any incident or case report.

prior_pra_refs.note: SMPD's response defers Item 3 (records for the thirteen search IDs) to the W012541 rolling production, adding that the Organizational Audit cannot be queried by individual search ID.

filed_because: Cross-checks whether ALPR searches tied to specific CAD/incident numbers correspond to real, documented calls and case dispositions, testing the Department's case-number-entry requirement against the underlying CAD/RMS record for each cited incident.
notes:
Closed 2026-09-24, the statutory due date. The response letter states a legal review was completed under Gov. Code § 7922.525 and that any redactions or exemptions were authorized by its signatory, the Police Technical Services Administrator.

Item 1: CAD incident reports produced for all three incidents, with license plates redacted (Cal. Const. art. I § 1; Gov. Code § 7922.000). Portions of the 202503280193 CAD withheld under Gov. Code § 7923.600 as law-enforcement investigative records.

Item 2: "No responsive records" — SMPD located no incident report, case report, or RMS case record for any of the three incidents.

Item 3: deferred to the W012541-041426 rolling production ("To the extent records associated with these search IDs exist"); the letter states the Organizational Audit "does not provide the ability to query or search for individual search IDs."

What the CADs show: every one has disposition "Completed" / CM and a blank Case Number field. 202504040004 (4/4/2025) and 202512050234 (12/5/2025) are REPO (repossessed vehicle report) calls phoned in by repossession companies — priority 3, no unit dispatched, closed about 3 and 10 minutes after creation. 202503280193 (3/28/2025) is a CIVIL (civil problem/advice) call over a landlord lockout, one unit on scene about 23 minutes. The § 7923.600 withholding on that CAD therefore sits on a call the City's own records type as CIVIL and close with disposition CM, with no case number and no report.

Altered file: Incident_2503280193_Redacted.pdf as released is not committed, because its Persons block leaves a third party's name, date of birth, and driver's license number unredacted. Incident_2503280193_Redacted.requester-redacted.pdf is a requester-altered copy: those three values are covered by gray boxes labeled REQUESTER, the City's black-box redactions are untouched, no other pixel of the page image is changed, and a footer stamp marks it as altered.
